description:
FILED s399, from the #324 diagnosis.

FOUR runners spawn SBCL, each with its own hand-written option string:

  Pl/t/PCLCore.pm          --control-stack-size 512 --noinform --non-interactive
                           (+ --core in core mode)
  sweep-perl-tests.pl      --control-stack-size 512 --noinform --non-interactive
                           --load runtime --eval skip-cache --load testlib
                           --load registry --eval current-test-file --eval load
  tools/run-perl-suite.pl  --core|--load runtime --load testlib (+ the stack
                           flag only since s399)
  ./runpcl                 --control-stack-size 512 --noinform --non-interactive
                           --load runtime --eval skip-cache --load <file>

They must agree about everything that changes what PCL *is* while a test runs
-- stack size, dynamic space, which libraries are loaded, the cache setting --
and they agree only by hand.  When one drifts, the difference reads as a PCL
bug in whichever measurement is the odd one out:

  * s399/#324: run-perl-suite.pl had NO --control-stack-size, so the companion
    suite ran PCL on SBCL's 2 MB default while every other measurement used
    512 MB.  Four files "crashed with control-stack-exhausted" in that
    measurement and nowhere else; one of them had its snapshot row blaming
    `(?{ CODE })` and a task (#324) filed against the wrong cause.  The probes
    in that task did not reproduce BECAUSE they were run through ./runpcl,
    which has the flag.
  * earlier: the sweep's `--load` of cl/pcl-test.lisp was the same shape of
    drift.

FIX: one helper that builds the sbcl command line, with the per-runner parts
(which files to load, which evals to run) as arguments -- Pl/t/PCLCore.pm
already does exactly this for the gate (`PCLCore::sbcl_prefix`), so the
mechanism exists and the work is to move it somewhere the other three can use
it (tools/lib/ next to PclTapAlign.pm) and route them through it.

BAR: no behaviour change is intended, so the acceptance is that each runner's
command line is BYTE-IDENTICAL before and after (print it and diff -- do not
just run the suites), then the gate, then one companion-suite run.  Any
DIFFERENCE the move exposes is a finding of the same class as #324 and needs
its own line in the commit message.

NOT IN SCOPE: choosing the values.  The stack size question (512 everywhere vs
something smaller for the suite, whose workers run a perl side and a PCL side
each, so --jobs 8 x 512 MB got a full run SIGTERMed) is on #324; this task is
only about there being ONE place to change it.


DONE s400 (b2cf620): tools/lib/PCLSbcl.pm, and it is FIVE runners, not four â
tools/pclperl-for-tests already went through PCLCore.  Acceptance met by
PRINTING each command line (PCL_SHOW_SBCL=1, kept in the tree) before and
after over six shapes: empty diff.  One difference preserved deliberately â
the sweep and ./runpcl never shell-quoted their paths (quote => 0).
Guard: tools/t/sbcl-prefix.t (13 rows).
subject: FOUR runners hand-write their own sbcl command line and drift — route them all through one helper (PCLCore::sbcl_prefix already is one)
